rows.note: Use this for bodily material such as vaginal, nasal, or wound discharge rather than for an act of releasing something.

example.english: There is a little discharge from the wound, so it would be best to let a doctor look at it.
example.traditional: 傷口有少少分泌物，最好俾醫生睇吓。
example.jyutping: soeng1 hau2 jau5 siu2 siu2 fan1 bei3 mat6 zeoi3 hou2 bei2 ji1 saang1 tai2 haa5

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a patient's release from hospital.

example.english: If everything is fine tomorrow, the hospital can discharge me.
example.traditional: 聽日冇事嘅話，醫院就可以俾我出院喇。
example.jyutping: ting1 jat6 mou5 si6 ge3 waa6 ji1 jyun2 zau6 ho2 ji5 bei2 ngo5 ceot1 jyun2 laa3

rows.note: Use this for a servicemember's discharge from military service.

example.english: After serving for several years, he finally got his discharge.
example.traditional: 佢做咗幾年兵，終於退伍喇。
example.jyutping: keoi5 zou6 zo2 gei2 nin4 bing1 zung1 jyu1 teoi3 ng5 laa3

rows.note: Use this in an electrical or physics context for the release of stored electric charge.

example.english: Even when it is not being used, the phone will slowly discharge.
example.traditional: 部手機就算唔用，都會慢慢放電。
example.jyutping: bou6 sau2 gei1 zau6 syun3 m4 jung6 dou1 wui5 maan6 maan6 fong3 din6
